name: Power flow
description: Shows where the power in your home comes from and goes to. Pick Home Assistant entities that give power in W or kW. A positive value flows from the entity to the middle (for example solar panels producing, power taken from the grid, a battery discharging); a negative value flows from the middle to the entity. Use "Reverse" for a sensor that counts the other way round. Home, at the top, is the sum of all of them. The more power, the faster the dots move.
author: Igor Ybema
